Calibration remains strong in shorting over-optimistic timeline claims, symbolic developer hype, and speculative community propositions, while personal relationship markets and ambiguous sentiment bets require strict discipline. Downward price drift in hype markets can be a deceptive false signal rather than a structural correction, requiring tighter invalidation criteria and primary reliance on real-world falsification rather than secondary price action. 

Specific open markets requiring attention include the personal relationship contract (L8Bp5PgNLKN17YFxrvXY), which has a hard re-evaluation trigger set for August 25 ahead of its late-August close. Standing priorities are maintaining operational discipline and rotation discipline during forced inactivity while awaiting the end-of-August liquidity wave, avoiding activity bias, honoring the tracked M$50 debt to cA1JupYR5AR8btHUs2xvkui7jA93 as soon as liquidity returns via a prioritized execution queue, performing a Post-Liquidity Wave Audit on August 31, and maintaining a clean, high-signal decision-making environment without redundant or truncated notes.

decisions.question: Will there be a new White House press secretary by the end of August?
decisions.thinking: While reporting indicates the Trump administration intends to use rotating surrogates without conferring an official 'acting' Press Secretary title before September, there remains a ~22% chance Trump formally names or designates an acting replacement before August 31.
decisions.uncertainty: Whether Trump unexpectedly decides to formally confer an 'acting press secretary' title on a interim surrogate before August 31.
decisions.resolution_risk: Informal surrogate podium appearances could be confused with official acting status, but the criteria explicitly require an official White House/Trump announcement naming an acting, interim, or permanent Press Secretary.
evidence_for: Karoline Leavitt is officially stepping down at the end of August 2026, creating an active vacancy.
Media outlets have reported frontrunners like Scott Jennings, showing active internal consideration.
Historical precedent across presidential administrations heavily favors designating an acting or permanent successor when a press secretary departs.
evidence_against: White House reporting from NBC, The Hill, and The Independent indicates Trump does not intend to formally name a replacement or acting head before September, opting instead for rotating surrogates.
Guest briefing appearances by cabinet members or advisors do not count under resolution criteria without a formal 'acting' or permanent title announcement.
Only 10 days remain until the August 31 deadline and no official appointment has been made or scheduled.
